attestation.known_overlap: SimpleWords v3 was trained on a private synthetic corpus; Disfl-QA was used only as a held-out evaluation set (model card). The hand-written items were authored after the model was trained; no overlap is known.

notes: SimpleWords v3 through Examples/LocalServer POST /v1/clean (protocol v1) in the engine repository. Outcomes and byte-offset edits come from the engine; guard rejections surface as fallback with the rejectedBy warning kept (decision S5). Must agree byte for byte with the mlx-lm row wherever the engine returns cleaned; a disagreement is an issue for the engine repository (docs/spec.md section 8).
